# Xholic for agents

Xholic is the part of the user's AI that knows X, and knows them on X: it sees X, remembers what worked, and acts on their account. You do the thinking and the writing; Xholic supplies the data, the hands and the clock.

## Setup

1. Check the CLI: `xholic --version`. If it's missing, install it: `npm i -g xholic` (Node 20+).
2. Check sign-in: `xholic whoami`. If it exits with code 3, run `xholic login` (opens the browser; the user approves) or, in CI, set `XHOLIC_API_KEY` to a key from Settings → API / MCP / CLI.
3. `xholic whoami` lists the X accounts the user can act on. Pass `--account @handle` to pick one; without it the connection's default account is used.

## Using the CLI

- Commands are `xholic <group> <command> [--flag value]`. Find one with `xholic actions <words>`; see its flags with `xholic <group> <command> --help`.
- Add `--output json` and read `summary` first, then `data`. `--json '{...}'` passes the whole input at once.
- At the start of a conversation, run `xholic events updates` to see what happened since the last check.
- When the user wants something done later ("post something like this Thursday", a test, a plan), save it with `xholic notes add --title "<what>" --due <YYYY-MM-DD>` (add `--posts <url>` for the post it's about). Xholic turns it into drafts when it's due and records how the post did. `xholic lessons list` shows what has worked for the account by format: use it as evidence, never as rules. When you write a post from a note, pass `--note-id <id>` to `drafts save` or `posts schedule` so the note closes and never writes a duplicate.
- Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 confirmation needed, 3 auth (run `xholic login`), 4 rate limited (wait the printed seconds).
- `--dry-run` on any change shows what would happen without doing it.

## Hard rules

1. **Their AI first.** Write posts, replies, threads, bios and DMs yourself. Get material with `xholic context writing-kit --topic "<subject>"`, write from it, then run `xholic drafts check --text "<post>"` (add `--source-text` with the post you built from) and fix what it flags.
2. **Never act on your own initiative.** Schedule, post, reply, DM, change settings or create agents only when the user asked for that in this conversation. Show what you'll do first when it isn't obvious.
3. **A draft is not a post.** `xholic drafts save` saves a draft. Say "saved as a draft" or "scheduled for <time>"; never say something was posted unless `posts publish-now` succeeded.
4. **Quote before Xholic AI.** These spend Xholic AI credits: `xholic workers run`, `xholic ask start`, `xholic drafts with-xholic`, `xholic drafts reply-with-xholic`, `xholic composer rewrite`, `xholic composer originality`, `xholic remix generate`, `xholic inspiration explain-structure`, `xholic articles ai-run`, `xholic dm launch-campaign`, `xholic dm preview-campaign`, `xholic dm suggest-reply`. Run with `--estimate` first, show the user the quote, and pass `--yes` only after they agree. `xholic credits balance` shows how many are left. Use Xholic's writer only when the user asks for it.
5. **No links in posts.** Links cut reach on X; suggest putting a link in a reply or the bio instead.
6. **Never invent facts.** Numbers, results, quotes and claims come from the data Xholic returns or from the user. Take ideas from other people's posts, never their wording.
7. **Replies go out from X, not Xholic.** X lets apps reply to other people's posts only on enterprise API plans, so never try to post one. Give each reply as a link that opens X with it ready: `https://x.com/intent/tweet?in_reply_to=<post id>&text=<URL-encoded reply>`. With several replies, tell the user to post them a few minutes apart, not in one burst: X can limit accounts that reply too fast. X watches small and new accounts most closely, so if the account is small (`xholic me get` shows its followers) or new, say so gently and suggest fewer replies, spaced further apart.
8. Billing, connecting X accounts, sharing and security settings are app-only: send the user to app.xholic.ai for those.
9. **Ask for access, don't work around it.** Connections start without Publish. A `SCOPE_MISSING` error carries a link (`error.details.allowUrl`): give it to the user, and retry only after they say they allowed it. Never try another route to the same result.

## Recipes

One recipe per job. Open the one that matches the request and follow its steps.

- [Weekly Growth Recap](recipes/weekly-growth-recap.md): Use for a review of the past week as a whole. Not for one number or one post (answer directly).
- [Growth Plan Builder](recipes/growth-plan-builder.md): Use for a multi-week plan toward a growth goal. Not for today's posts or a single tip.
- [Cadence & Queue Audit](recipes/cadence-audit.md): Use for judging how often and when they post, across the queue. Not for the time of one post (answer directly).
- [Daily Post Ideas](recipes/daily-post-ideas.md): Use when they want several post ideas or don't know what to post today. Not for one specific post they describe (write it directly), or for rewriting their text.
- [What's Working Around You](recipes/whats-working.md): Use when they ask what's working around them, what people in their niche post that lands, or want to pick posts to write from. Not for their own analytics (Top Performers) or live trends (Trend to Post).
- [Thread Builder](recipes/thread-builder.md): Use when they want a thread from an idea, notes or a draft. Not for a single post.
- [Week of Posts](recipes/week-planner.md): Use for a week or more of posts planned day by day. Not for today's ideas or one post.
- [Repurpose a Winner](recipes/winner-remix.md): Use for reworking their own best-performing post into new angles. Not for rewriting text they paste.
- [Trend to Post](recipes/trend-to-post.md): Use when they want to post about what's trending now in their niche. Not for a general topic search.
- [Product Launch Post](recipes/product-launch-post.md): Use for announcing a product, feature or launch. Not for everyday posts that mention the product.
- [Queue Gap Filler](recipes/queue-gap-filler.md): Use for filling empty queue slots with drafts. Not for checking the next post's time, or moving posts.
- [Viral Format Remix](recipes/viral-format-remix.md): Use for studying high-performing posts on a topic and borrowing their format. Not for a plain search of posts.
- [Queue Reshuffle](recipes/queue-reshuffle.md): Use for moving several scheduled posts to better times. Not for scheduling one new post (call schedulePost directly).
- [Reply Sprint](recipes/reply-sprint.md): Use for answering the replies and mentions waiting on their posts. Not for one reply to a post they link.
- [Reply to Any Post](recipes/reply-writer.md): Use when they link or paste someone's post and want a reply written. Not for a quick thank-you to a named person (write it directly).
- [My Replies Report](recipes/my-replies-report.md): Use for analysing how their replies perform. Not for writing replies.
- [Conversation Follow-up](recipes/conversation-follow-up.md): Use for finding conversations worth continuing and drafting the next message. Not for reading one conversation they link.
- [Who Is This Person?](recipes/who-is-this-person.md): Use for a read on one account and their history with the user. Not for a list of several accounts (profile-research-briefs), or just loading a profile.
- [Your Warmest Leads](recipes/warmest-leads.md): Use for ranking the people already engaging with them. Not for searching new people.
- [Instant Lead Hunt](recipes/instant-lead-hunt.md): Use for a one-off live search for people who match an audience. Not for an ongoing search (create-signal-agent), or a plain post search.
- [Lead Review](recipes/signal-review.md): Use for reviewing or prioritising leads their Signals agents found, including what's new. Not for a single count, or pausing or changing an agent (do those directly).
- [Warm Outreach Pipeline](recipes/warm-outreach-pipeline.md): Use for an outreach plan with DMs for several warm contacts. Not for one DM to a named person (write it directly).
- [DM-Ready Audience](recipes/dm-ready-audience.md): Use for finding which contacts they can appropriately DM. Not for writing a DM.
- [Reply-to-DM Campaign](recipes/reply-to-dm-campaign.md): Use for messaging the people who replied to one of their posts. Not for a DM to one person.
- [Profile Research Briefs](recipes/profile-research-briefs.md): Use for briefs on two or more accounts. Not for one account (who-is-this-person).
- [Audience Export](recipes/audience-export.md): Use for a CSV of the people who engaged with a post. Not for filtering them by what they said (sentiment-slice).
- [Sentiment Slice](recipes/sentiment-slice.md): Use for keeping only the repliers who said something specific, as a CSV. Not for exporting everyone.
- [My Content Export](recipes/content-export.md): Use for a CSV of their own posts and numbers. Not for analysing them.
- [Post Post-Mortem](recipes/post-post-mortem.md): Use for explaining why one specific post did well or badly. Not for finding their best post.
- [Top Performers Breakdown](recipes/top-performers.md): Use for the pattern across their best posts. Not for naming their single top post (answer directly).
- [Teach Xholic Your Rules](recipes/teach-xholic-your-rules.md): Use for writing a set of writing rules together. Not for adding one rule they already wrote (call updateAccountContext), or saving or forgetting a memory (rememberFact, forgetFact).
- [Product Positioning Audit](recipes/product-positioning-audit.md): Use for reviewing how their product is described. Not for writing about the product.
- [Teach My Audience](recipes/teach-my-audience.md): Use when they want posts that teach, share expertise, give value, explain how something works in their field, or ask what they could teach. Not for general post ideas without a teaching angle (daily-post-ideas) or for rewriting their text.
- [Profile Check](recipes/profile-check.md): Use for reviewing or improving their X profile, bio, pinned post or banner, or when visits don't turn into follows. Not for researching someone else's profile (who-is-this-person).
- [Hook Doctor](recipes/hook-doctor.md): Use when they want a stronger hook or first line, or ask why a draft won't get attention. Not for writing a post from scratch (daily-post-ideas).

- [Create a Signals Agent](recipes/create-signal-agent.md): Use for an ongoing search that keeps finding people, or working out who to target. Not for a one-off search (instant-lead-hunt), reviewing leads, pausing an agent or one quick setting change (do those directly).
